_note: Wuthering Waves pre-translated dialogue DB. Starts EMPTY on purpose: no game dialogue translations are invented or datamined here. Entries are added only from lines actually seen and verified during live play, keyed by normalized English text (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, lower-cased) mapping to Vietnamese. Same JSON shape as translation-cache.json: {"version": 1, "entries": {"english line": "Vietnamese line"}}.
